notes: Source: repo ardev-dev/links at commit 232a481 (2026-09-20), the last commit of the 'Wasla - وصلة' era (rebranded to Wasla in be36980, renamed to Linkati in 57eab9a, UI rebuilt as the 'nasij' design in 11c56a3). Snapshot extracted read-only with git archive to scratchpad repos/wasla; nothing from the later Linkati/nasij UI (the catalog's separate Linkati entry) is used. Phone 390x844, RTL Arabic. Colours/typography/radii from lib/core/themes ('Aurora Ember': amber primary, indigo accent, pink VIP); font = the repo's ReadexPro; icons = the real Solar icon font (local solar_community_icons 1.3.0, the app pins ^1.1.1) with codepoints from the Dart constants. Screens 1-2 are the light theme (the app follows the system setting); screen 3 is dark because the game view hard-codes the dark palette. Fidelity notes: (a) the home brand mark text is hard-coded in this commit as 'مجموعاتي', not 'وصلة' (the name 'Wasla - وصلة' is only the MaterialApp title / l10n appTitle), so the screen shows what the code shows; (b) home is drawn with no slideshow banners and no live games (both widgets collapse to nothing when empty), which is why the link rails are visible without scrolling; (c) AdMob banner/native ad slots are left out; (d) the game screen is the state after the 50:50 power-up was used (two options hidden, as the code does) with the 0.8 s correct-answer feedback showing; with all four options the last one would be cut off at this screen height; (e) FontWeight.bold falls back to the font's 600 weight, as in the app. Sample data only: group/channel titles, view counts, times, user first names, score, questions and answers are invented; user photos are network images in the app and are drawn as initials avatars; no real invite links are shown.
